name: ai-enablement
description: AI Enablement: install, upgrade and extend an application's AI layer — the screen-aware agent drawer runtime, tools and toolsets (MCP-compatible), Agent Skills, agents, permissions, relays, a dev workspace for in-app tool authoring, examples, tests and lifecycle tooling (an agent skill).
comment: The runtime, relay.mjs and the lifecycle scripts need Node 18+; scripts/verify.mjs and the browser tests need Node 22+ (global WebSocket); the Office-file tests need Node 21.2+ (deflate-raw).
